set.outcome: **`block` checkbox in the dev rail head, and the ✕ finally pinned right** — /framework/dev/DevBar/. The checkbox writes `window.$BLOCKRELOAD` directly (Socket reads it live in `reload()` and `changed()`); deliberately NOT persisted through settings.js, since a block surviving a reload reads as live reload being broken. The ✕ was never right-aligned: the `margin-inline-end: auto` on `.dev-hint` was dead — `.flex > * { margin: 0 }` in @layer util beats @layer theme at any specificity. Replaced with `flex-grow: 1`, which no layer zeroes. Both decisions recorded in readme.md; page.js documents the new control.
